arStrings.szText: In the chambers beyond, Laalish has enslaved those like us. Now nothing remains but a fleshy husk.
Slaying these Sorcerers will grant you access to the deepest recesses of the halls. Beware, conventional attempts to fight the demon will fail.

To succeed, you must weaponize the demon’s name against the Possessed Sorcerer trapped in the final chamber. The binding can only occur after the host has been destroyed, a fleeting opportunity for you.
